steps.note: Create an RFQ event that can be used for both role checks.
Configure the event as an RFQ.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the bid sheet.
Commit a bidding schedule so the event can be published.
Invite the QA Vendor account that will perform the positive-role check.
Publish the event so bid submission is available.
Confirm the event reached a usable project page.

args.need: sign in as a user without the Vendor role on this tenant and attempt manual, Excel, and quick-fill bid submission, recording whether Procol refuses or omits each action

steps.note: The catalog has no step for obtaining or using a non-Vendor user's session.
Switch to the invited Vendor portal session for the positive comparison.
Open this event's RFQ bid sheet as the Vendor.
Submit a manual quote as the Vendor.
Assert that the Vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit a revised quote as the same Vendor.
Assert that the Vendor can submit the revision.
